title: 只保留最近 N 个 checkpoint

standard.summary: 限制最多保留多少个中间 checkpoint（最近的 N 个），旧的自动删除。0 = 保留所有。
standard.effect: 防止磁盘被大量 checkpoint 占满，仅保留最近几个版本用于对比。
standard.whenToUse: 磁盘空间有限时推荐设为 3~5，只保留最近几个版本。
standard.avoidWhen: 希望保留全部 checkpoint 对比时设为 0。

standard_en.summary: Caps how many intermediate checkpoints are kept (the most recent N), deleting older ones automatically. 0 = keep them all.
standard_en.effect: It stops the disk filling up with checkpoints and keeps only the last few versions for comparison.
standard_en.whenToUse: 3~5 is advisable when disk space is limited, keeping only the last few versions.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Set it to 0 when you want to keep every checkpoint for comparison.

advanced.principle: 每次保存新 checkpoint 时，检查现有 checkpoint 数量，超过 N 则删除最旧的（按时间戳排序）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 删除是不可逆的，若误删了最优 checkpoint 则无法恢复。建议至少保留 3 个以上。

advanced_en.principle: Each time a new checkpoint is saved, it checks the number of existing checkpoints and deletes the oldest when above N (sorted by timestamp).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Deletion is irreversible; if the optimal checkpoint is deleted it cannot be recovered. Keep at least 3.
